results.note: The pier itself, from the official site of ONE°15 Marina Panwa Phuket, the marina at the same address (88/88 Moo 7 Wichit) that is taking over Visit Panwa Pier. It shows the old stilted pier building, the raised entrance deck with the white house-shaped frames (as in phuketferry's 422 px entrance photo and Love Andaman's crew photo on this pier), the green channel and the tip of the new pontoon. Saved as a 16:9 crop (x 848, y 0, 1200x675) of the 2048x2048 original, with no people in frame; the attention crop of the square original would pick the tool-strewn deck with three workers, so do not re-crop it. Rejected: ONE°15's cover and site hero (CGI rendering of the 2027 marina), its other photos (barge, fuel tanks, cafe, logo), Love Andaman's crew portrait and lounge shots, its fleet photo (text graphic, place unconfirmed), Sail Away party shots, stock images on Openferry and Bookaway. Commons (5 km geosearch, Thai names), Openverse and a Flickr CC geosearch found nothing of the pier.
